hooks.command: out=$(.venv/Scripts/ruff check . 2>&1); rc1=$?; out2=$(.venv/Scripts/ruff format --check . 2>&1); rc2=$?; if [ $((rc1 | rc2)) -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg r "Ruff gefaald - fix dit eerst:\n${out}\n${out2}" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":$r}}'; fi
